feature_contract.goal: Bind actual game-authored D3D9 SM3 programmable Draw RGB and independent alpha blend equations to the native D3D11 output merger with lifetime-safe state caching and safe D3D9 fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Read actual game blend factors and equations; create/cache compatible native D3D11 blend state and bind to programmable game Draw/DrawIndexed.
Unsupported factors/ops fail closed without modifying original D3D9 game draw; native blend cache is cleared across device teardown and Reset.
A source-bearing native DX11 material commit exists and the selected final exact SHA passes Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD required gates.

integration_path: Intercept actual D3D9 programmable game Draw/DrawIndexed and retrieve RGB plus separate-alpha blend factors and operators
Translate supported factors and independent alpha operations to native D3D11 RT blend description with conservative fallback on unrepresentable state
Cache native per-device D3D11 OM blend states and bind them in live native game draw; invalidate cache on Reset/device recreation
batch_components: Game-owned D3D9 RGB/independent-alpha render-state capture and constexpr translation
D3D11 output-merger state cache/Reset cleanup integrated with native programmable Draw/DrawIndexed

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Compile-time native SM3 RGB and independent-alpha equation regression and actual C++ OM binding source; exact-SHA native Windows Build SUCCESS.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Unsupported blend factor/op and independent alpha cases return false without rewriting the original D3D9 game draw; cached states reset on native device teardown.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 source draw blend state -> native D3D11 RT blend desc/BlendState cache -> OMSetBlendState -> Draw/DrawIndexed; original D3D9 game render/input/FFB retained.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Real-game SM3 OM blend source integrated and exact-SHA CI verified; runtime gameplay menu, vehicle selection, race native pixel/frame output and HMD remain UNTESTED.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native Draw remains opt-in and fail-closed with original D3D9/DX9Ex renderer, game input, FFB and SkyGlow preserved; DXVK branch frozen.
